diagnostic_v2.inference: Thread oversubscription is not the dominant cause of the C9 memory requirement.

decision.reason: The observed process alone reached roughly 15.5 GB RSS before host shutdown, leaving no adequate operating-system or solver headroom. A materially larger memory environment is required before further production execution is scientifically auditable.
acceptable_environment_classes: GitHub larger runner with at least 32 GB RAM if the repository/account has verified access
self-hosted GitHub Actions runner with at least 32 GB RAM
independent HPC/cluster environment with at least 32 GB RAM and a reproducibly pinned QE/pseudopotential bundle

restart_rule: Do not rerun C9 production on the rejected standard hosted environment.
Do not reduce the frozen 4x4 supercell, cutoffs, k-mesh, force threshold, ESM convention, adsorption matrix, mobility models or any other physical setting to fit the runner.
When a qualifying environment becomes available, first execute one explicitly non-admissible frozen-case resource/provenance diagnostic.
Only after the diagnostic demonstrates adequate memory headroom may the full 18-case production matrix resume with unchanged science.
